svg.title: Vancomycin structure with the seven heptapeptide residues numbered
svg.desc: Skeletal structure of vancomycin (PubChem CID 14969) drawn with stereochemistry from that record. The light red tint marks the seven monomer-derived moieties specified by the antiSMASH adenylation-domain predictions: N-methylleucine (1), two chloro-beta-hydroxytyrosines (2 and 6), asparagine (3), two 4-hydroxyphenylglycines (4 and 5), and 3,5-dihydroxyphenylglycine (7). The glucose-vancosamine disaccharide on residue 4, the two chlorines, the N-methyl group, and the three oxidative cross-links are tailoring features outside the monomer predictions.
